Planning budget: US$1,800–2,800 / monthConsider: April–June; September–NovemberBase area: Village centre

What the ranking means

The default order is an editorial shortlist: Chiang Mai for budget, Lisbon for city choice, Tallinn for a focused routine, Ponta do Sol for an organised village community, Barcelona for urban life and Tbilisi as a lower-budget alternative. It is not a measured community league table.

Monthly USD ranges are our planning estimates for one person: furnished accommodation, utilities, a workspace allowance, ordinary meals and local transport. Flights, visa fees, insurance, taxes and dependants are excluded. Short lets and peak seasons can cost much more. Use the budget sort as a starting point, not a price quote.

Internet: comparable current city medians were not available for every base, so we do not substitute a country average or an operator's advertised speed. Check Ookla's current index, then request a room-specific download, upload and latency test. Coworking spaces per capita are not scored: directory coverage and city boundaries are inconsistent. Named workspace examples are evidence of facilities, not a complete inventory.

Sources & booking checks

  • Official immigration and workspace links are on each card. Reviewed 15 September 2026; programmes and availability can change.
  • Ask your employer about overseas work, data security and insurance. Obtain advice specific to your citizenship, residency and business before assuming a tax outcome.
  • Use a trial stay, keep a second connection and confirm quiet call space. Respect local housing rules and residents.
